name: Data Engineering & Big Data
description: Modelling, moving and processing data at scale: pipelines, warehouses and lakes, Spark and streaming.

nodes.name: Data engineering
nodes.desc: What data engineers build: sources, sinks, batch versus streaming and the modern data stack.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe what data engineers build, from sources to sinks, and compare batch and streaming within the modern data stack.
topics: Components of the modern data stack
Roles of engineers, analysts and scientists

nodes.name: Analytical SQL
nodes.desc: Window functions, CTEs, grouping sets and writing efficient analytical queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write efficient analytical SQL using window functions, CTEs and grouping sets.

nodes.name: Data modelling
nodes.desc: Star and snowflake schemas, facts and dimensions, and when to denormalise.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design star and snowflake schemas with fact and dimension tables and decide when to denormalise.

nodes.name: File formats
nodes.desc: CSV, JSON, Avro and Parquet; row versus columnar storage and compression.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose between CSV, JSON, Avro and Parquet based on row versus columnar layout, schema support and compression.

nodes.name: ETL & ELT
nodes.desc: Extracting, transforming and loading data, and pushing transforms into the warehouse.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build extract, transform and load processes and decide when to push transformations into the warehouse with ELT.

nodes.name: Orchestration
nodes.desc: Pipelines as DAGs: scheduling, retries, backfills and idempotent tasks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to orchestrate pipelines as DAGs with scheduling, retries, backfills and idempotent tasks.

nodes.name: Data quality
nodes.desc: Validation checks, data contracts and testing pipelines before bad data spreads.
nodes.summary: You will be able to protect pipelines with validation checks, data contracts and tests that stop bad data from spreading.

nodes.name: Batch pipeline
nodes.desc: Build a scheduled pipeline that ingests a public dataset daily, validates it and loads a warehouse.
nodes.summary: You will build a scheduled pipeline that ingests a public dataset daily, validates it and loads it into a warehouse.

nodes.name: Data warehouses
nodes.desc: Columnar MPP warehouses, clustering, materialised views and cost-aware queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use columnar MPP warehouses efficiently with clustering, materialised views and cost-aware queries.

nodes.name: Data lakes
nodes.desc: Object storage, lake layouts and lakehouse table formats with ACID transactions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise data lakes on object storage and use lakehouse table formats that provide ACID transactions.
topics: Object storage as a data lake
ACID transactions with Delta and Iceberg

nodes.name: Distributed storage
nodes.desc: How HDFS-style and object stores split, replicate and place data across machines.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain how HDFS-style and object stores split, replicate and place data across many machines.

nodes.name: Partitioning
nodes.desc: Choosing partition keys, bucketing and dealing with data skew.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose partition keys and bucketing schemes and handle data skew in large datasets.

nodes.name: MapReduce
nodes.desc: The map, shuffle and reduce model and why it scales.
nodes.summary: You will be able to express computations in the map, shuffle and reduce model and explain why it scales across clusters.

nodes.name: Apache Spark
nodes.desc: DataFrames, lazy evaluation, transformations versus actions, and the shuffle.
nodes.summary: You will be able to process data with Spark DataFrames, understanding lazy evaluation, transformations, actions and the shuffle.
topics: Spark architecture with driver and executors

nodes.name: Spark tuning
nodes.desc: Reading query plans, joins strategies, caching, partition sizing and avoiding spills.
nodes.summary: You will be able to tune Spark jobs by reading query plans, picking join strategies, caching and sizing partitions to avoid spills.

nodes.name: Spark job
nodes.desc: Process a multi-gigabyte dataset with Spark and publish aggregated tables.
nodes.summary: You will process a multi-gigabyte dataset with Spark and publish aggregated tables for analysis.

nodes.name: Event logs & Kafka
nodes.desc: Partitioned logs, producers, consumer groups, offsets and retention.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use Kafka-style partitioned logs with producers, consumer groups, offsets and retention.

nodes.name: Stream processing
nodes.desc: Windows, watermarks, late data, state and exactly-once processing.
nodes.summary: You will be able to process streams with windows, watermarks, state and exactly-once guarantees while handling late data.

nodes.name: Change data capture
nodes.desc: Streaming database changes from transaction logs into downstream systems.
nodes.summary: You will be able to stream database changes from transaction logs into downstream systems with change data capture.

nodes.name: Governance & lineage
nodes.desc: Catalogues, lineage, access control and handling personal data.
nodes.summary: You will be able to manage data catalogues, lineage, access control and personal data handling.

nodes.name: Streaming pipeline
nodes.desc: Build a real-time pipeline from a source database through a log to live aggregates.
nodes.summary: You will build a real-time pipeline from a source database through a log to continuously updated aggregates.
